description: The waybill card's key, assigned once and never reused: a retired card leaves a gap (36). generate_waybill_cards.py rewrites this file and numbers its cards from 1, which would renumber the cards after a gap; that is open for the owner (docs/data/sidecars.md).
The industry the card is for; interchange for the through cards (ADR-039).
The name across the top of the card: the industry's industries.csv name, or INTERCHANGE. Kept because external/sts-helpers reads it; www/scripts/tests/test_industry_ids.py checks it matches the id.
loaded, inbound_empty (an empty to a load spot), outbound_empty (a generic empty home) or interchange (a through car).
The spot usage the card goes to, as spot_assignments.csv names it. Empty on outbound empties and interchange cards.
The industry's spot numbers the card serves: one (6), a range (1-3) or two ranges. — on interchange cards, empty on outbound empties.
IN to the island or OUT. Empty on interchange cards.
The group the lower table of the card prints for a load named in detail.
The car type. Empty on outbound empties, which take any car.
The shipper, for an inbound load or an interchange card.
The receiver, or the yard an outbound empty returns to.
The connection the car moves over.
